in_hebrew.name: Cecilio
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Latin: Brother of Ceasar
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Cecilio הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Roman family name 'Caecilius', meaning 'belonging to Ceasar'. In Christianity, Saint Cecilia is the patron saint of music and musicians.

in_latin.name: Cecilius
in_latin.meaning: Latinized form of Greek name, means 'blind' or 'weak'
in_latin.long_meaning: Cecilius is a Latin name derived from the Greek name Κηκίλιος, which is an epithet for someone who is blind or weak. In the early Christian church, the name Cecilius was used to refer to Saint Cecilia, a martyr and a patron saint of music. The name has its roots in the Latin word caecus, meaning 'blind', and was originally used to describe someone who was physically or spiritually blind. In the context of Christian tradition, the name Cecilius has come to symbolize the power of faith and the ability to overcome obstacles, even in the face of adversity.
